stem: Which additional component is specifically supported in an ADHD assessment for a child with learning difficulties?

options.text: Psychometric testing including cognitive and academic achievement measures, with teacher feedback
Routine lumbar puncture to exclude neuroinflammation
Exercise tolerance testing to confirm hyperactivity severity
Overnight sleep study in all children before rating scales are used
Neuroimaging as the main investigation in school-aged children

explanation: Psychometric testing including cognitive and academic achievement measures, with teacher feedback is the supported additional assessment component. It helps assess learning difficulties and gathers information from school to inform the ADHD assessment.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 84

optionExplanations.A: Correct because psychometric testing with cognitive and academic achievement measures, together with teacher feedback, is specifically supported as part of the assessment.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because routine lumbar puncture is not a standard component of ADHD assessment.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because exercise tolerance testing does not assess ADHD severity.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because overnight sleep study is not required for all children before rating scales are used.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because neuroimaging is not the main investigation for school-aged children with suspected ADHD.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
